subgroup stream whose Type Flags value 0x10 is encoded as the 2-byte varint 8010 rather than the one-byte 10. Section 11.4.2 words its third invalidity rule as "values of 128 or greater (i.e., any value that requires more than a one-byte variable-length integer encoding)". Those two clauses come apart under Section 1.4.1's allowance for non-minimal encodings: the value here is 16, well below 128, but its encoding is two bytes. This corpus reads the rule as a bound on the value and is permissive on receive, strict on send, so the vector is decode-only. An implementation that reads the parenthetical as normative will reject it

subgroup stream header with Type Flags 0x16, whose SUBGROUP_ID_MODE is the reserved 0b11 — must close the session. Section 11.4.2 lists three invalid conditions and this is the first: "Values with SUBGROUP_ID_MODE set to 0b11. This mode is reserved for future use." Computing all three rules yields 0x10-0x15, 0x18-0x1D, 0x30-0x35, 0x38-0x3D, 0x50-0x55, 0x58-0x5D, 0x70-0x75 and 0x78-0x7D, byte for byte the enumeration draft-19 wrote into the figure. vectors.description: subgroup stream header with Type Flags 0x20, whose bit 4 is clear — must close the session. Section 11.4.2: "Values where bit 4 is not set. Bit 4 MUST be 1 for SUBGROUP_HEADER." This is the opposite of the datagram rule, where bit 4 is reserved and MUST be zero; the datagram conditions do not transfer here, and SUBGROUP_HEADER has no "unspecified bit" condition at all because bits 0 to 6 are all specified for it. A value with bit 4 clear also falls outside the 0b0XX1XXXX stream-type pattern of Table 3. The bytes after the Type Flags are those of the subgroup-single-object vector, which decodes
vectors.error_detail: SUBGROUP_HEADER Type Flags must have bit 4 (0x10) set

vectors.description: subgroup stream header whose Type Flags decode to 144, encoded as the minimal two-byte varint 8090. Bit 4 is set and SUBGROUP_ID_MODE is 0b00, so the value passes the first two conditions and fails the third: "Values of 128 or greater". All values draft-20 defines fit in one byte
vectors.error_detail: SUBGROUP_HEADER Type Flags of 128 or greater are invalid
